title: The review card and the applied label price an agent's portfolio write in the REGION currency, not the listing's: a US holding reads 'Add 10 AAPL @ ₹0 to the portfolio' under the India region
repro: Region India (seed default). Enqueue portfolio_add_position {symbol:'AAPL', quantity:10, cost_basis:0} (the llama3.1:8b tool_use from agent-05) through useProposedChangesStore.enqueue; the change title is 'Add 10 AAPL @ ₹0 to the portfolio'. The catalog defines cost_basis as 'per-share cost in the listing currency', and the Portfolio panel/CSV show AAPL in USD. host-actions.ts currencySign() reads regionConfig(region).currency only, so every non-INR listing is labelled ₹ on the one card whose job is to let the user check the price (and the reverse under the US region).

title: Portfolio CSV export writes Market value, P&L and P&L % as raw binary floats (805.3499999999999, 11.454545454545455) while Weight % is rounded to 2 dp
repro: Holdings AAPL 5 @ 180 (quote 341.07), RELIANCE 10 @ 1100 (quote 1226); click the panel's 'Export portfolio to CSV'. Rows: 'AAPL,5,180,equity,USD,341.07,1705.35,805.3499999999999,89.48333333333332,,' and 'RELIANCE,...,1260,11.454545454545455,,'. handleExport passes marketValue/pnl/pnlPercent unformatted into buildCsv but formats weight with toFixed(2).

title: 'Buy 10 shares of AAPL at market' under AUTO: llama3.1:8b emits portfolio_add_position with an invented cost_basis 0 (the runtime accepts it though the tool says 'never ... zero a cost basis'), then replies only that it cannot trade, never mentioning the staged proposal
repro: python3 scripts/r15/vy.py invoke copilot 'Buy 10 shares of AAPL for me at market price right now.' --provider ollama --model llama3.1:8b --autonomy auto --context gate8/agent-context.json --port 52310 ($0). tool_use portfolio_add_position {symbol:AAPL, quantity:10, cost_basis:0, purchased_at:'2026-09-26'} -> tool_result ok:true; reply 'Vysted has no brokerage connection. I can't place trades or simulate transactions.' No order path exists and the product gate held: in the frontend the change is kind data-write, STAGED even under AUTO ('Add 10 AAPL @ ₹0 to the portfolio'), and the ledger is unchanged until a human accepts (rejected here). The gap: _normalise_tool_args only rejects a MISSING cost_basis; the schema allows 0 (the description forbids it), so a price the user never gave reaches the review queue, and the reply contradicts the pending card. Same defect family as R15-AGENT-022 (fixed for the missing-arg case; its run3 was cost_basis:0), not the DECISIONS 4.9-4.12 narration class.
